# Fetch all pages of received payment requests
all_requests = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_requests.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print("Total requests fetched:", len(all_requests))

# Calculate total amount of payment requests in the last 7 days (including today)
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Current date/time is 2023-06-03 23:58:00 (from context)
now = datetime(2023, 6, 3, 23, 58, 0)
start = now - timedelta(days=6)  # 7 days including today means from 6 days ago at 00:00:00
start = start.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
end = now

total = 0.0
for req in all_requests:
    created = datetime.strptime(req["created_at"], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    if start <= created <= end:
        total += req["amount"]

print("Total requested in last 7 days:", total)
